capabilities.name: Buy inside an AI assistant
capabilities.question: Can an AI assistant buy from a merchant for you without you leaving the chat?

US.note: Google AI Mode and Gemini (agentic checkout and Universal Cart), Microsoft Copilot Checkout, Perplexity Instant Buy with PayPal, Meta's Muse agent and Alexa+ shopping all work for US users; ChatGPT Instant Checkout launched in the US, but OpenAI moved checkout to merchant apps in March 2026.

BR.note: Magalu's AI assistant Lu sells inside WhatsApp: shoppers search, pay by Pix or card and track the order without leaving the chat (7.7 million users since November 2025). ChatGPT, Copilot and Perplexity checkout are not offered in Brazil, and Gemini's Buy button needs Google Pay agentic checkout, which works only in the US and Australia.

capabilities.name: Marketplace agent buys for you
capabilities.question: Can a marketplace's own AI agent buy things for you?

US.note: Amazon's Alexa for Shopping (with Rufus) can auto-buy at a set price for all US customers, Walmart's Sparky auto-reorders repeat items, and Amazon Buy for Me (buying from other brand sites) is still a beta for some US users.

companies.name: OpenAI
companies.role: Co-created the Agentic Commerce Protocol and lets ChatGPT buy from merchants, now mainly through merchant apps, plus a UPI pilot in India.

companies.name: Google
companies.role: Runs agentic checkout and Universal Cart in AI Mode and Gemini on its open Universal Commerce Protocol for US shoppers, has announced UCP checkout for the UK, and is testing Flipkart checkout in India.

companies.name: Microsoft
companies.role: Copilot Checkout lets US shoppers buy from PayPal, Stripe and Shopify merchants inside Copilot.

companies.name: Perplexity
companies.role: Instant Buy lets US users pay merchants with PayPal inside Perplexity answers.

companies.name: Amazon
companies.role: Alexa+ and Alexa for Shopping (with Rufus) order, auto-buy and use Buy for Me on other sites for customers; outside the US Alexa+ is in early access.

companies.name: Walmart
companies.role: Sparky, Walmart's shopping agent, automatically reorders repeat items for US customers; in Mexico, Walmart México's Sparky only gives product advice.

companies.name: Flipkart (super.money)
companies.role: Flipkart's payments app super.money is rolling out agents that shop on Flipkart for users, and Flipkart is Google's checkout test partner in Gemini.

companies.name: Razorpay
companies.role: Agentic Payments lets Indian merchants take UPI payments from ChatGPT and Claude in a pilot.

companies.name: NPCI
companies.role: Runs UPI, whose Reserve Pay and UPI Circle features let AI agents pay without a PIN prompt each time, in pilot.

companies.name: Anthropic
companies.role: Claude can order from Zomato, Swiggy and Zepto with UPI in an Indian pilot, and Indian merchants can take Claude payments through Razorpay.

companies.name: Stripe
companies.role: Agentic Commerce Suite and Shared Payment Tokens let merchants list products for agents and accept agent payments.

companies.name: Shopify
companies.role: Agentic Storefronts puts store catalogs into ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and Gemini, Copilot and Meta's Muse; stores can be in any country, but the agents reach mainly shoppers in the US, Canada and Australia.

companies.name: PayPal
companies.role: Agent Ready and Store Sync let PayPal merchants be found and paid in Copilot, Perplexity and Google AI checkout.

companies.name: Meta
companies.role: Its Muse agent lets shoppers in the US and Canada buy from Shopify stores without leaving Meta.

companies.name: Mercado Libre
companies.role: Its Mercado Pago assistant, Mago, makes payments and transfers but does not shop on the marketplace; a Mercado Libre buying agent was reported as planned in June 2026 and has not launched.

companies.name: Magazine Luiza (Magalu)
companies.role: Its AI assistant Lu sells inside WhatsApp, from product search to Pix or card payment and order tracking.

companies.name: Rappi
companies.role: Announced a WhatsApp AI assistant in Colombia that takes orders in plain language and by voice note; it has not launched yet.

repos.name: Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP)
repos.role: Open standard from OpenAI and Stripe that lets an AI agent check out a cart at a merchant on behalf of a buyer.

repos.name: Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP)
repos.role: Open protocol, led by Google with retailers and platforms, that lets an AI agent find products, build a cart and pay at any merchant that supports it.

repos.name: Medusa
repos.role: Open-source commerce engine whose store and admin APIs let agents browse products, build carts and place orders.

repos.name: Saleor
repos.role: Headless commerce platform with a GraphQL API (and an official MCP server) that agents can use to search products, manage carts and place orders.

repos.name: WooCommerce
repos.role: WordPress store plugin that ships a built-in MCP endpoint, so an agent can read products and orders and act on a shop.

repos.name: Spree Commerce
repos.role: Open-source commerce platform with a local MCP server that lets an agent manage a store through chat.

repos.name: Vendure
repos.role: Headless commerce platform whose typed GraphQL shop API is built to be called by LLM tools, MCP servers and agent frameworks.

repos.name: Bagisto
repos.role: Open-source store and multi-vendor marketplace platform from India, with official agent skills and an MCP server for AI tools.

repos.name: Beckn-ONIX
repos.role: Adapter that connects buyer and seller apps to Beckn open networks such as India's ONDC, so any app or agent can discover and order from any seller on the network.

repos.name: ONDC Protocol Specs
repos.role: API specification of India's Open Network for Digital Commerce, which lets any buyer app search and order from sellers on any other app.
